snippet.title: Halo CE - Mercury Rising release trailer
snippet.description:
Mercury Rising is a custom campaign mission based on a multiplayer map Mercury Falling. It's using a variety of cut and custom assets all of which have been edited to some extent to work properly. The map is fairly open and you can take different routes to reach your destination which will give you a different experience every time you play.

Download: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3021510694
